compiled_state.title: As a brainstorm user, I see an Inputs dimension probed during Phase 1 dialogue
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Add an Inputs dimension to the Phase 1 Tell-Me-More dimension table in plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md and add a non-optional Inputs bullet to the Understanding Summary template.

**Why**: This is the upstream surface that introduces the cemented-premise detection pattern. Without the dimension, downstream stories (S2 gap analysis, S3 assumption category) have nothing to reference.

**Scope**:
- IN: Inputs row in Tell-Me-More table with example list (text content, lookup tables, reference data, policy/rules data, model weights, copy/templates); non-optional Inputs bullet in Understanding Summary template with two permitted values (explicit source statement OR "no external inputs"); no TBD escape.
- OUT: Gap-analysis enforcement (covered by S2); structural-marker rendering (covered by S5); assumption-category red-team integration (covered by S3).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, the Phase 1 Tell-Me-More dimension table in `plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md` includes an `Inputs` row with the documented example list, verified by structural test asserting the row is present and example list contains the documented categories.
  ← Satisfies: "Cross-file structural consistency"
- When this story is complete, the Understanding Summary template requires a non-optional `**Inputs**` bullet with one of two permitted values (explicit source statement OR "no external inputs"), with no TBD escape; verified by structural test on the template text.
  ← Satisfies: "Cross-file structural consistency"
- When this story is complete, a trivial brainstorm session run against a refactor / hook-fix prompt completes through Phase 1 Tell-Me-More and produces an Understanding Summary with the Inputs bullet populated as "no external inputs" — verified by Read/Grep against the resulting epic ticket description, not just by inspecting the template file.
  ← Satisfies: "No-input feature replay"

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] The Phase 1 Tell-Me-More table is also being modified by epic fdeb-4c03 (Surface dimension); coordinate merge ordering and final column position; later-landing epic rebases.
- [Testing] Structural tests on prompt-file content are change-detector-prone — pin assertions to canonical markers (heading text, key phrases) rather than line-by-line content per behavioral-testing-standard.md Rule 5.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
